TEXT:
[FI] Under the blazing sun, my chest was swelling with 
expectations, waiting for Ayase to finish changing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] The time has finally come!

[FI] I'm probably wearing a pretty unpleasant 
expression right now. I'm aware of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Still, she's pretty late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ah, it's hot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hey, she's still not done yet?

[FI] Sure, it supposedly takes girls a lot of time to 
change, but now I'm starting to get worried.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hm? What's all the commotion about?

[FI] I wasn't paying attention, but there's a huge crowd 
at that side of the beach.

[FI] It doesn't seem like Ayase's coming any time soon, 
so I guess I'll take a look?

[FI] Urged on by my curiosity, I pushed through the 
crowd until...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Wha--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What the heck are you up to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] I-It's about time you noticed! Help me out here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, I'm glad to see you're enjoying soaking in the 
sun. See ya later!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Wait! You're just gonna leave me here?! Help me 
out! We're friends, right?

[FI] Hey, wait. Who made me your friend? Don't make 
these people think I'm with you on this!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Hurry up already! Before that person gets back!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That person?

[FI] Who's "that person" anyway? I don't think I know 
anyone who's cruel enough to jus--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] O-Onii-san? What are you doing here...
[FI] Oh, wait. I know one. A particularly cute one at that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ayase. What's up with this chaotic situation...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It seems like we were followed...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Uh huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] She came in order to spy on us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] All the way to Atami?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] All the way to Atami...
[FI] All that talent, wasted on this, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Enough already, just help me out!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, this is totally your own fault.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're abandoning me?! You gotta be kidding...

[FI] Yup, she's at fault, but this is just too pitiful. I'm 
sure this idiot has reflected on her actions, I'll try 
the gentle approach.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey, Ayase...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Would you mind if I helped her out?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I would mind, Onii-san.
[FI] Sorry, Kanako. I'm in no position to help you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] W-Wait! You could at least deal with the others in 
the same way though?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] If you want me to spill the beans, you know what 
to do, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Come on, she looks like she's regretting it, right? 
Just let it slide for me, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...O-Only this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] I-I'm saved~

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] So who else is involved?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Look over there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ki-Kirino?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Crap, they found out?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-She's fleeing!
[FI] What the heck is she up to?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Damn it!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Onii-sa--

[FI] I chased after Kirino's escaping figure, she didn't 
even turn to look back.

[FI] But naturally, I couldn't catch up to her. Her figure 
quickly got smaller and smaller...

[FI] Of course things turned out this way. She's on the 
track team.
[FI] As I got back, Ayase was standing there alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh? Where'd Kanako disappear to?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...She escaped.

[FI] Somehow, Kanako managed to escape her fate this 
time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see.

[FI] I felt a bit sorry for Ayase, but I breathed a sigh of 
relief. Seeing that, Ayase started pouting.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] You're so mean, Onii-san...
